Type: geometric low-pile area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, modern, bohemian
Materials: short dense low pile
Colors: black, off-white cream, high contrast
Shape: flat low pile, allover stepped diamond pattern in a repeating grid, thin black edge border, bold and graphic, large visual presence
Feel: bold, graphic, lively
Goes with: white walls, light wood, black metal, solid neutral sofas; Scandinavian, modern or monochrome rooms
